title: Global Newland L-Shaped Desk with Single Pedestal — 60"W x 72"D
body_html:
A Canadian-made corner workstation that turns a tight footprint into a full L-shaped command center — worksurface, return, and a single pedestal for files within arm's reach.

The Global Newland L-Shaped Desk pairs a 60"W primary surface with a 72"D return in a 1" thermally fused laminate top, finished with a tough 2 mm matching edge that stands up to years of institutional use. A single pedestal keeps files and supplies close, leveling glides settle it on any floor, and the reversible design assembles for left- or right-hand layouts. Built in Canada and available across the full Newland laminate palette, it scales cleanly from private offices to open-plan and training rooms.

Key features

  • 1" thick thermally fused laminate worksurface with durable 2 mm matching edge
  • L-shaped footprint pairs a primary worksurface with a single pedestal for stored files within reach
  • Leveling glides included to stabilize on uneven floors
  • Reversible build — configures for left- or right-hand applications
  • Engineered for quick and easy assembly
  • Modular Newland components scale from private offices to open-plan and training spaces

Who it’s for

Private offices and open-plan workstations in municipal, education, and healthcare environments that need a durable, configurable corner desk with on-board filing.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
